name: When is it time to repaint interior home walls and ceilings?

mainEntity.name: When is it time to repaint interior home walls and ceilings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repainting is typically recommended every five to seven years for high-traffic zones like hallways, kitchens, and family rooms, while bedrooms and formal spaces may last longer. Clear signs you need a fresh coat include scuffed baseboards, fading color, peeling around moisture-prone areas like bathrooms, or visible settling cracks at corners and door frames. If your home has undergone settling repairs or remodeling, repainting unifies the repaired drywall with existing walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repaint every five to seven years, or sooner if you notice scuffs, drywall settling cracks, fading, or peeling near humid bathrooms and kitchens.
